Title: Silver Fox - Stage-One Payload
Description: Stage-one dropper payload. Delivered via trojanised installer. Stable hash across filename rotation. Drops further stages to C:\Users\Public or ProgramData. Silver Fox campaign (MS Security Blog 2026-09-01).
RecommendedActions: Quarantine file. Isolate device. Check Public and ProgramData for additional dropped files. Review scheduled tasks for SYSTEM-level Defender exclusion writes.

Title: Silver Fox - Later-Stage Payload (Philips Masquerade)
Description: Later-stage payload masquerading as Philips Speech Driver. Uses DLL sideloading. Silver Fox campaign (MS Security Blog 2026-09-01).
RecommendedActions: Quarantine file. Isolate device. Investigate parent process and loaded DLLs. Check for persistence via Run keys or scheduled tasks.

Title: Silver Fox - Networking Payload
Description: Networking and C2 communication payload. Establishes outbound connections to C2 infrastructure. Silver Fox campaign (MS Security Blog 2026-09-01).
RecommendedActions: Quarantine file. Isolate device. Review all outbound connections from device in Advanced Hunting DeviceNetworkEvents.

Title: Silver Fox - Persistent Payload (Process Injection)
Description: Persistent payload that injects into legitimate user processes. Survives reboot. Silver Fox campaign (MS Security Blog 2026-09-01).
RecommendedActions: Quarantine file. Isolate device immediately. Assume credential theft possible - reset all user credentials on affected device.

Title: Silver Fox - TrueUpdate Loader
Description: TrueUpdate framework loader. Retrieves and executes additional payloads from C2. Enables hands-on-keyboard activity. Silver Fox campaign (MS Security Blog 2026-09-01).
RecommendedActions: Quarantine file. Isolate device immediately. Full forensic triage required - TrueUpdate indicates active operator access.

Title: Silver Fox - Persistent/Networking Payload
Description: Combined persistence and networking payload. Disables Windows Update and deletes VSS shadow copies. Silver Fox campaign (MS Security Blog 2026-09-01).
RecommendedActions: Quarantine file. Isolate device. Check VSS shadow copy status. Verify Windows Update service state. Full forensic triage required.
